text: Sequential assessment 2026-09-12: retain P3 optional post-release modeling extension. No stimulus-feature amplitude implementation appears in current model/profile source, and the required trial regime is itself unfinished. Direct signed queries already have their separate required contract; do not make this feature model a prerequisite for them. Original acceptance correctly distinguishes penalty-dependent feature/residual allocation from unique scientific identification and requires training-fold-only preprocessing. Preserve those conditions, bounded feature dimension/conditioning and consistent amplitude/penalty normalization; no unbounded feature matrix or added nonlinear search. Before implementation choose a concrete consumer and predictive comparison, then qualify independent augmented solves; do not infer a marginal-likelihood model from penalized optimization. Core PHRF release and C0/B0 remain independent. Source-only assessment, no model admission.
